properties.name: Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium
properties.description: Rabat's large football stadium, rebuilt and reopened in September 2025, about 7 km from the city centre. No match or tournament role is assigned here until officially confirmed.

reported.source: SONARGES, as relayed in project research; not re-checked

capacity.note: Reported figures disagree. Do not show a number to visitors until an official source confirms it.

properties.match_note: Matched by location, not by name: this OSM stadium relation has no name tag, but its centre is about 50 m from the coordinates Wikipedia gives for the stadium. Another unnamed stadium relation (19165479) lies about 350 m away, probably a sub-facility; not used.
